summary: The self-hosted v86/Alpine x86 guest compiled and ran Go 1.27.4, channels, the real Go tests and separate TinyDB writer/reader processes with requests outside the lab blocked. These timings describe the initial local browser investigation, not a performance-ready course or an offline claim. Edited-source transfer and fresh-session recovery are verified separately.
limitations: Initial image was built with a host-emulated prepared cache. CI prepares the 386 cache natively where available.
No claim of native CPU performance or learning effectiveness.
